items.headline: La Avenida Cultural District proposal appears on December 1 draft agenda
items.meetingBody: Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole
items.summary: The November 18 Rules and Open Government Committee agenda, which covered the December 1 draft council agenda, listed "Establishment of the La Avenida Cultural District." The item is attributed to Councilmembers Ortiz, Mahan, Campos, Tordillos, and Candelas.

items.headline: Townhomes and duplex with commercial space proposed near Civic Center Drive
items.summary: The November 18 Planning Commission agenda listed a vesting tentative subdivision map for condominium purposes covering 14 townhomes and a duplex building with commercial space at 860 and 858 Civic Center Drive and 1526 Alviso Street. The project was listed as exempt from CEQA under AB 130 (2025).

items.headline: Scott Boulevard site eyed for 69-stall parking lot after demolition
items.summary: The November 18 agenda listed a conditional use permit for a 69-stall surface parking lot at 2740 Scott Boulevard. It also covered architectural review to completely demolish the existing vacant structures and a minor use permit for offsite parking.

items.headline: Neighbor appeals Rita Court home addition approval
items.summary: The November 18 agenda listed an appeal of a staff-level approval for an addition at 2261 Rita Court. The addition is 517 square feet on the first floor and 1,000 square feet on the second floor of a single-story house on a 6,272-square-foot lot.

items.headline: Gymnastics facility proposed in Corvin Drive warehouse
items.summary: The November 18 Planning Commission agenda listed a conditional use permit to let 7,116 square feet of an existing 16,576-square-foot warehouse at 3051 Corvin Drive be used as a gymnastics facility.

items.headline: Council agenda lists pause on data center and big energy projects
items.summary: The November 17 City Council agenda included an item titled "Pause on Data Center and Large Energy Use Project Approvals and Develop Urgency Ordinances." The title points to a possible halt on approvals for data centers and other large energy users while the city drafts urgency ordinances.

items.headline: Council closed-session agenda lists two lawsuits against Cupertino
items.summary: The November 17 City Council agenda listed a closed-session conference with legal counsel on two existing cases in Santa Clara County Superior Court: Lixin (Leon) Chen, et al. v. City of Cupertino, et al., and Yes in My Backyard, et al. v. City of Cupertino, et al. The agenda gives only the case names and court, not the claims.

items.headline: Council agenda includes ordinance on councilmember compensation
items.summary: The November 17 City Council agenda listed an ordinance amending Cupertino Municipal Code Section 2.16.020 on City Council compensation. It was set as a regular agenda item, not on the consent calendar.
